description_zh: 在Mission St与9th St交叉口，Zoox AV在Mission St上因红灯停车，绿灯后起步；一辆SamTrans公交车在9th St上右转进入Mission St，其前部突出的自行车架侵入AV车道，与AV左侧前翼子板发生侧擦碰撞。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle (Vehicle 1) in autonomy, traveling northeast on Mission St, was stopped in lane for a red traffic light at 9th Street.

A SamTrans bus (Vehicle 2), with a front-mounted triple-bike rack extending past the width of the bus on the driver's side, was traveling southeast on 9th Street and attempting a right turn onto Mission St.
The protruding edge of the bike rack was encroaching into the Zoox vehicle's travel lane as the bus was executing the right hand turn.
As the light turned green the Zoox vehicle inched forward and attempted to steer away from the bus.
Just as the safety operator disengaged from autonomy, the protruding edge of the bike rack made contact with the driver's side fender on the Zoox vehicle.
evidence.reason: Existing vehicle primitives can represent the bus turning right at an intersection (junction_turn, position=cross) conflicting with the ego AV starting straight from a red light. The bike rack is treated as part of the bus; bus vehicle_class is preserved. Weather clear, morning, traffic light control.
